notes.title: Alpha 1.11: Armour Sets, Boss Arenas + Incentives, New Ability Card
notes.content:
[h2][b]Armour Sets[/b][/h2][p]Armour sets have been added to the game! Their chance of dropping is rolled with each enemy kill. There are 3 [b]Tiers[/b] for each set and [b]5 Quality[/b] [b]Tiers[/b] for each piece of gear.[/p][h3]Sets: [/h3][p][b]Melee, Sorcery, Armour, Hybrid [/b][i](more to come!)[/i][/p][h3]
Quality: [/h3][p][b]Poor, Common, Rare, Elite, Legendary[/b][/p][p][/p][h3]Tiers:[/h3][list][*][p][b]0 Bosses Killed:[/b] Tier 1 only[/p][/*][*][p][b]1–3 Bosses Killed:[/b] Tier 1 and 2 (weighted more toward Tier 2 the more bosses killed)[/p][/*][*][p][b]4 Bosses Killed:[/b] Tier 2 and 3[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Enhanced Armor & Attribute System[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Armor Stat Integration: Equipment stats now properly integrate with character attributes for accurate stat calculations[/p][/*][*][p]Quality-Based Bonuses: Equipment quality now provides meaningful stat multipliers that scale with item rarity[/p][/*][*][p]Set Bonus System: Rewards players for collecting and equipping matching armor pieces[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Boss Fight System Overhaul[/b][/h2][list][*][p][b]New Boss Arena Mechanics:[/b] Boss encounters now lock the player into an arena. Enemy spawner is paused while the fight is active, but remaining enemies still join until killed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Fight Restrictions:[/b] Stat upgrades/buffs from stat orbs are disabled during boss fights to increase challenge (temporary until boss AI is improved).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boss Fight Incentives:[/b]
• Starting and defeating bosses restores full player health and provides bonus potions
• Killing bosses unlocks higher tier armour drops:[/p][list][*][p]0 Boss Kills: Tier 1 only[/p][/*][*][p]1–3 Boss Kills: Tier 1 and 2[/p][/*][*][p]4 Boss Kills: Tier 2 and 3[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Card Abilities:[/b]
• Orbital Sentinels passive ability added
• Dodge Proc mechanics improved (better collision detection and damage tracking)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Combat Improvements[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Revised Damage Scaling: Updated strength and sorcery scaling for better combat balance[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]User Interface & Quality of Life[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Improved Item Tooltips: Equipment now displays better stat information with quality indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Equipment Management: More accurate stat calculations for armor[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Skill Descriptions: Card abilities now show detailed info including attribute scaling[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2][b]Bug Fixes & Performance[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Inventory Fixes: Issues with item removal and ammunition handling resolved[/p][/*][*][p]Combat Stability: Fixed various edge cases in damage calculation and buff/debuff systems[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Npc Striking Hotfix
notes.content: Fix npc weapons stuck in strike state when not in an attack style

notes.title: New Spell + Attribute Scaling + UI Changes
notes.content:
- Balanced Attributes scaling better
- Added Cards Tab to inventory for better organization
- Inactive sigil to suggest boss locations
- Removed armour and magic pen from all npcc attacks for now
- Fixed Item Display so it scrolls and displays stats/description better in inventory

notes.title: Alpha 1.0.2 - Bug Fixes, Scaling
notes.content:
- fixed gpu resident drawer was disabled on medium quality
- respec was not resetting armour and magic resist properly
- fixed npc weapons being stuck in striking state after recycling
- npc scaling now starts at level 8
